highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves managed rendering performance and makes WebGPU browser applications easier to build.
highlights_body: Image pixel transfers and HarfBuzz text handling now avoid avoidable allocations, while Android continuous texture rendering follows the display refresh rate.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows the display clock
bullets.detail: Automatic continuous frames for Android GL texture views are paced by display refresh callbacks, avoiding redraws driven by buffer-swap throughput while preserving explicit render requests.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered managed streams release their backing data
bullets.detail: Front-buffered managed streams no longer retain their initial data after it is no longer needed.

bullets.lead: Image copying and text shaping allocate less
bullets.detail: Managed pixel copies can take a direct raster path, and HarfBuzz text and feature conversion reuse stack or pooled storage to reduce allocation overhead without changing decoded values.

bullets.lead: WebGPU browser builds package native C++ support
bullets.detail: The WebGPU C++ port is now built into libSkiaSharp.a, so browser applications no longer compile it during their final link while retaining the required JavaScript glue.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Improved WebGPU browser builds by packaging the native C++ support with libSkiaSharp
